companies.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
companies.catalogue_notes: LIC has no single all-products list with UINs: individual plans sit on per-category pages under https://licindia.in/web/guest/ (endowment-plans, whole-life-plans, money-back-plans, term-assurance-plans, pension-plan, unit-linked-plans, health-insurance-plans, micro-insurance-plans, riders, gift-city-plans; UINs are in the plan names/links); group products at /pension-group-schemes-new-product and /pension-group-schemes-withdrawn-products. LIC's withdrawn list (233 rows) gives financial year only, so withdrawn_date is null except where a source states a date; the FY is in sub_category. Older UIN versions of plans still sold are listed as Withdrawn with sub_category 'older version of active <UIN>'. Plan numbers (alt_code) change on revision (e.g. 915 became 715). Conflicts on LIC site: ULIPs New Pension Plus 512L347V01 and Index Plus 512L354V01 are on the active pages but also in the FY 2024-25 withdrawn list (kept Active, recheck); riders 512B203V03/512B209V02/512A211V02 appear on both active and withdrawn lists (kept Active; New Jeevan Anand brochure confirms the first two); group UINs 512N274V03, 512N335V01, 512G300V01, 512B213V01, 512N352V01 appear on both new and withdrawn group pages (kept Active, recheck). Withdrawn-list typos reconciled from LIC link slugs: ADDB rider 2017-18 row set to 512B209V01, Cancer Cover 2020-21 row to 512N314V01; New Jeevan Suraksha-I has no UIN saved because LIC lists the same 512N205V01 as New Jeevan Dhara-I; duplicate 512N337V06 row (FY 2024-25) dropped. Smart Pension 512N386V01 is also listed on the group page (kept as one Individual row). Wealth Builder Plus is a GIFT City product with a non-standard UIN. Specs for most active plans still to be filled; brochure URL for New Jeevan Anand is a third-party mirror.

positives: Family protection and peace of mind, with budget-friendly premiums (Policybazaar reviews, mostly 2015-2021)
Quick, hassle-free claim handling and useful riders and policy perks in older reviews (Policybazaar)
negatives: Online portal and app failures: login lockouts, OTP delays, password resets and failed premium payments (about 10 of 20 visible Trustpilot reviews)

Staff or agent misconduct and weak grievance handling (about 3 of 20 Trustpilot reviews)

MouthShut shows 3.27/5 with no review text retrieved, so the picture varies sharply by source and by review vintage.

reviews.notes: A second MouthShut product page for LIC shows 2.64/5 (925641395, page 3) with no review text retrieved. Policybazaar reviews are old and all rated five stars.

negatives: Premiums seen as high or returns seen as modest for the cost (about 5 of 67 Policybazaar reviews, all from 2016)

eligibility.notes: Entry age min 18 completed years, max 50 nearer birthday. Premiums run for the policy term. Monthly mode only via NACH; salary-savings mode also offered. Basic sum assured in multiples of Rs 5,000 up to Rs 4.5 lakh, Rs 50,000 up to Rs 9 lakh, Rs 1 lakh above. Mode rebates 2% annual / 1% half-yearly plus high-sum-assured rebate.

benefits.death: In term: higher of 125% of basic sum assured or 7x annualised premium, plus vested simple reversionary bonuses and final additional bonus, never below 105% of premiums paid. After the term: basic sum assured.
benefits.maturity: Basic sum assured plus vested simple reversionary bonuses and final additional bonus, if all due premiums are paid.
benefits.other: Surrender (higher of guaranteed or special value) after year 1 with one full year's premium; paid-up once one full year's premium is paid; loan up to 50% of surrender value in force (75% after two years' premiums).

products.sub_category: Unit-linked pension accumulation plan

eligibility.max_premium_text: No limit, per Board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Vesting age 30-70; regular pay min Rs 30,000 yearly / 15,000 half-yearly / 3,000 monthly; limited pay min Rs 40,000 / 20,000 / 5,000; single/limited term ranges not legible in brochure; accumulation can be extended to age 70 (total term max 35 years)

benefits.death: Higher of fund value plus 1.5% terminal addition, or 105% of total premiums paid
benefits.maturity: Fund value plus 1.5% terminal addition at vesting; take a full annuity, commute up to 60% and annuitise the rest, or extend accumulation to age 70; up to 50% of proceeds can buy an annuity from another insurer
benefits.other: 5-year lock-in; partial withdrawals after lock-in up to 25% of fund value, max 3 times, for specified needs

ulip.loyalty_additions: 0.30% of average fund value each year from policy year 15 (terms of 15+ years); 1.5% terminal addition at death or vesting
ulip.premium_allocation_charge: Regular/limited pay: 6.00% yr1, 4.75% yr2, 4.00% yrs 3-10, 2.50% yr 11+; single pay 3.00%
ulip.policy_admin_charge: Rs 45/month in years 1-5, Rs 70/month from year 6 (capped Rs 500/month)

key_features: Seven pension funds from money market and bond to equity, Top 300 and balanced
Unlimited free switches; free premium redirection from year 2
Loyalty additions after year 15 plus 1.5% terminal addition
Flexible vesting: annuity, partial commutation or deferred vesting to age 70
products.tax_benefits: Benefits per prevailing tax law; individual life policies GST-exempt since 22 Sep 2025
products.description: Unit-linked pension plan from SBI Life that builds a retirement corpus through seven funds and offers flexible annuity options at vesting.

benefits.death: Lump sum: the higher of (a) sum assured on death plus vested reversionary bonuses and any terminal bonus, or (b) 105% of total premiums paid to date. Sum assured on death is the greater of sum assured or 11 times annualized premium. Paid even after survival installments. If death is by suicide within 12 months of risk start or revival, nominee gets 80% of premiums paid or surrender value, whichever is higher.
benefits.maturity: Lump sum of 40% of sum assured plus vested reversionary bonus (if declared) and terminal bonus (if any), payable on survival to term end. Can instead be deferred, taken as instalments over 2-7 years, or split between lump sum and instalments.
benefits.survival_income: Four rising installments of 15%, 20%, 25% and 30% of sum assured (90% in total) at set policy years, every 4th or 5th year depending on schedule, while the policy is in force.
benefits.guaranteed: Fixed shares of sum assured: 90% through survival installments and 40% at maturity; bonuses are not guaranteed.
benefits.return_of_premium: Death benefit has a floor of 105% of premiums paid; free-look cancellation refunds premium less risk premium and certain costs.
benefits.loan: Available in financial emergencies once the policy has a surrender value; capped at 50% of surrender value; FY 2025-26 interest is 8.00% a year, compounded half-yearly.
benefits.other: Surrender: higher of special or guaranteed surrender value; guaranteed value needs at least 2 full years of premiums. Reduced paid-up option after year 1 if first full year's premium is paid. Revival within 5 years of first unpaid premium. Grace period 30 days (yearly/half-yearly) or 15 days (monthly). Free look: 30 days.

eligibility.max_premium_text: 150000 for non-POS channels; no fixed cap for POS, subject to underwriting
eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: Cap of 25000000, set by premium, entry age, policy term and premium payment term, subject to underwriting rules
eligibility.notes: Non-POS: entry age 3 to 65 minus policy term; maturity age 18 to 65. POS: entry age 3 to 60; maturity age 18 to 75. Policy term depends on premium payment term (PPT): 5-pay 10 or 15 yrs; 6-pay 12 or 18 yrs; 7-pay 14 or 20 yrs; 10-pay 15 or 20 yrs. Limited-pay only. Modal factors as % of annualized premium: yearly 100, half-yearly 51, quarterly 26, monthly 8.8. Minimum basic sum assured is formula-based; sample figures at a 20000 premium (entry ages 3 and 50) range from 136908 to 249212. Channel split for the 25000000 cap is not clear in the source.

benefits.death: Higher of (a) basic death benefit plus accrued guaranteed yearly additions, or (b) 105% of premiums paid to date, excluding extra premium. Basic death benefit is the higher of 11 times annualized premium (entry age under 50) or 7 times (age 50 and above), and a guaranteed minimum of 110% to 120% of basic sum assured (BSA), depending on premium payment term. Unpaid premiums due are deducted if death occurs in the grace period. For POS policies, non-accident death within the first 90 days pays only premiums paid, excluding GST and cess.
benefits.maturity: On survival to the end of the policy term, with policy in force and all premiums paid: BSA plus accrued guaranteed yearly additions (GYA, added each premium year at 7% to 10% of cumulative annualized premium, depending on premium payment term) plus guaranteed loyalty addition (GLA, 10% to 20% of BSA, depending on premium payment term). Outstanding loans with interest are deducted.
benefits.other: Surrender: higher of guaranteed surrender value (after two full policy years of premiums) or special surrender value (after year one with a full year's premium), paid as a lump sum. Loan up to 50% of surrender value, minimum 10000; insurer sets the rate (currently 8.95% p.a.). If premiums are missed after at least one full year is paid, the policy becomes reduced paid-up by default, with no further additions. Lapsed or reduced paid-up policies can be revived within five years of the first unpaid premium, with revival charges (currently 9% p.a. of outstanding premiums); health evidence is needed after six months. Grace period: 30 days (15 days for monthly mode). Free look: 30 days from receiving the electronic policy. Suicide within 12 months of risk start pays 80% of premiums paid.

savings.bonus_type: none (non-participating); benefits come from guaranteed additions
